summary: The milestone completed 10 experiments in 13.2 minutes, with 3 classified as compute-bound. SOTA plain-text relation generation with exact prefix guidance was the longest listed compute-bound run at 12.32 minutes; the supplied data does not identify the cause of that duration.
bottlenecks_identified: SOTA plain-text relation generation with exact prefix guidance set the critical path at 12.32 minutes, while the reconstructed timestamps provide no phase-level cause.
The GPU report captures one point in time rather than the full compute-task window, so it cannot quantify utilization throughout execution.

Capture task-scoped GPU utilization from compute-task start through completion instead of relying on a closeout snapshot.

Record loaded-model count and selected runner in every compute launch receipt, and route confirmed parallel multi-model launches through DualGPURunner while retaining single-GPU execution for single-model launches.

Add task-owned GPU telemetry for every compute-bound launch.

meta_reflection: The locked classification does not identify GPU idle during compute-bound work, so the closeout snapshot is not treated as a compute bottleneck. Without phase traces, task-window GPU samples, or model-concurrency receipts, the cause and quantified savings remain unavailable.
